display_name: Crisis 2028: Taiwan Strait Full Blockade & Carrier Clash
briefing_opord: OPORD 28-101: PLA Eastern Theater Command establishes a multi-axis maritime and air blockade around Taiwan. DF-21D and DF-26 Anti-Ship Ballistic Missiles (ASBM) establish a 1,500km anti-access envelope. US Carrier Strike Group (USS Gerald R. Ford) and ROC defenses coordinate BVR intercepts with F-35A, Loyal Wingmen, and coastal Patriot/BrahMos batteries to break the encirclement.
key_features: CSG Carrier Air Wing Alpha Strikes
